meta.description: Population rules (GDD section 7): public support, riots, revolution, rebels, secession and assimilation. Support is 0-100. Game-design defaults to be tuned in Phase 13 (balance).

support.comment: Each province moves toward a target support every turn. Effects are points of support.

war.comment: Points of support for the whole country. Battles and provinces: per event, at most maxPerTurn a turn. A peace counts as won or lost from peaceScore war score. defenderRally: target support for the attacked country while the war lasts (rallying around the flag).

revolution.comment: A revolution breaks out when national support is below the threshold while riots have lasted long enough in a large enough share of the population.

assimilation.comment: Cost per inhabitant of the province, times the cultural distance. Unrest lasts while the province assimilates.
